group.title: Returning a rental bicycle
group.passage:
F1: I'm returning bicycle number eighteen. I booked it for the whole afternoon, but the rear tire lost air after about twenty minutes.
M1: I'm sorry about that. Did you have to walk all the way back? We could have sent our recovery van if you'd called.
F1: Fortunately, I was near the riverside cafe, so it wasn't far. I would still like to ride along the coast tomorrow.
M1: I'll refund today's rental fee. For tomorrow, I can reserve a different bicycle and have our mechanic check it before you arrive.
F1: That would be great. Could you keep a helmet for me too?
M1: Certainly. I'll put both items aside under your name, and you can collect them after nine.
group.passageZh:
女：我來還十八號自行車。我預約了整個下午，但後輪騎了約二十分鐘就漏氣。
男：真抱歉。你是一路走回來的嗎？如果你當時有打電話，我們原本可以派救援車。
女：幸好我在河邊咖啡館附近，並不遠。我明天仍想沿海騎車。
男：今天的租金我會退還。明天可以預留另一輛，並請技師在你到之前檢查。
女：太好了，也可以幫我留安全帽嗎？
男：當然，兩樣都會用你的名字預留，九點後可以領取。
